OFFICE OF THE SECRETARY OF TRANSPORTATION
WASHINGTON, D.C. 20090
JUN 22 1973
Mr. Bruce Blanchard
Director, Environmental Project Review
U. S. Department of the Interior
Washington, D. C. 20240
Dear Mr. Blanchard:
This is in reply to your letter of May 25, 1973, requesting clarification of the Department of Transportation's position regarding the applicability of Section 4(f) to certain public school properties. A formal opinion of Counsel on this question has not been prepared by the Department. However, the position which the Department has taken on previous occasions is as follows:
1. School property serving only as a recreational area for the school has not been considered to be covered by Section 4(f).
2. An area which serves the recreational needs of the community, as well as the school, is considered to be covered by Section 4(f) if found to be significant by the officials having responsibility for providing recreational opportunities to the community.
In view of your recent inquiry, we have raised this matter again with our Office of the General Counsel. It is currently under review in that office, and we will furnish you with any further information or changes in the above policy which may result from that review.
Sincerely,
Benjamin O. Davis, Jr.
Assistant Secretary for Environment,
Safety, and Consumer Affairs
